text.p: Lithuanian acetate yarn producer Dirbtinis Pluoshtas said on Monday that its profit after the first five months was 5.667 million litas and its profit for May was 2.194 million litas.
"For the first five months, our net profit was 5.667 million litas," Benjamina Jakavichiene, adviser to the general director for financial issues, told Reuters.
"For the month of May the net profit was 2.194 million litas," he added.
Last year, Dirbtinis Pluoshtas had a 3.171 million litas profit for the first five months and 896,000 litas profit for the month of May in 1996, Jakavichiene said.
Dirbtinis had turnover of 113.654 million litas in the first five months of this year and May turnover of 24.220 million litas, Jakavichiene said.
The company's turnover for the first five months of last year was 85.970 million litas and 14.110 million litas for the month of May last year.
Dirbtinis Pluoshtas had a 1996 net profit of 4.09 million litas and a 3.47 million litas profit for the first four months of this year.
